name: Yoshua Bengio
bio: Yoshua Bengio is a professor at Universite de Montreal, founder of Mila (Quebec AI Institute) and its scientific director until 2025, and co-president of the nonprofit LawZero launched in 2025. Bengio shared the 2018 ACM A.M. Turing Award with Geoffrey Hinton and Yann LeCun, and chaired the International AI Safety Report.
known_for: Deep learning pioneer and 2018 Turing Award co-recipient
